evidence: Creating "Plan team offsite" increased active count from 5 to 6 and the task appeared in the active list.

Created "Plan team offsite" with description, deadline Sep 15, priority High, and 2 prerequisites (Buy groceries, Schedule dentist appointment); all details were retained and displayed, with "2 prerequisites incomplete" shown.

Edited "Schedule dentist appointment" changing title, description, deadline, priority, and prerequisites (added Buy groceries) - all changes saved and displayed correctly. Deleting "Buy groceries" removed it from the active list and updated dependent tasks' prerequisite state accordingly.
Completing "Review project proposal", "Complete tax filing", "Submit final report" each moved the task out of Active into Completed view, with active/completed counts updating each time.

Active tab shows only non-completed tasks with matching count badge; Completed tab shows only completed tasks (strikethrough styling) with matching count badge; switching between tabs updates the list correctly.

Assigned Buy groceries + Schedule dentist appointment as prerequisites of Plan team offsite at creation; saved task showed "2 prerequisites incomplete". Adding Buy groceries as a prerequisite of Schedule dentist appointment via edit also correctly updated blocking state.

Blocked tasks show a warning label and disabled complete toggle; after completing all prerequisites of "Complete tax filing" and "Submit final report" their complete toggles became enabled and warning disappeared.
Single incomplete prerequisite showed 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'; two incomplete prerequisites showed "2 prerequisites incomplete".
Complete toggle button was disabled (non-interactive) for tasks with incomplete prerequisites and became enabled/clickable only once all prerequisites were completed.
When editing "Schedule dentist appointment" (which is a prerequisite of "Plan team offsite"), "Plan team offsite" was excluded from the prerequisite selection list, preventing a circular dependency.
Entering only whitespace ("   ") in the Title field kept the "Create Task" button disabled, preventing submission; task list remained unchanged.
Completed tasks remained visible in the Completed view across multiple actions until explicitly deleted (e.g., "Organize desk" stayed completed until deleted, reducing completed count from 5 to 4).

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves dependent completed tasks in an invalid completed+blocked state
actual: Reopening completed prerequisite "Review project proposal" was allowed without restriction. Its completed dependents "Complete tax filing" and "Submit final report" remained listed in the Completed view/count (still marked completed) while simultaneously showing a "Prerequisite incomplete" blocking warning and a disabled toggle button - i.e., simultaneously completed and blocked, which the requirement explicitly disallows.
